text.content:
The city's biggest open-air market and stolen-goods exchange.

Region: Kabuki Roundabout, Kabuki, Watson (#5)
Controlled by: The Tyger Claws take 10%; the G4 own the rooftops
The feel of it: Food, chrome, stolen goods and anything else you can carry
Danger: SC 6

Its back stalls sell the decks that don't come registered to your Neuroport, the programs Night Corp didn't approve, and pirated quickhacks. Mama Nguyen moves stolen goods in her dumpling steamers. The convenience stores nearby sell ten-kilo bags of "runner ice", and the bathhouses rent ice baths by the hour.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.03, 06, 08
